verses.text: Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Command di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘Una go observe to offer my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, of pleasing aroma to me, for dem appointed season.’
You go tell dem, ‘Dis na di offering made by fire wey una go offer to di Lord: two male lambs of di first year without blemish day by day, for one continual burnt offering.
Di one lamb you go offer for di morning, and di other lamb you go offer for evening,
with one tenth of one ephah of fine flour for one meal offering, mixed with one fourth of one hin of beaten oil.
Na one continual burnt offering, wey dem ordain for Mount Sinai for pleasing aroma, one offering made by fire to di Lord.
Im drink offering go be one fourth of one hin for each lamb. For di holy place you go pour out one drink offering of strong drink to di Lord.
Di other lamb you go offer for evening. Like di meal offering of di morning, and like im drink offering, you go offer am, one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma to di Lord.
On di Sabbath day two male lambs of di first year without blemish, and two tenths of one ephah of fine flour for one meal offering, mixed with oil, and im drink offering:
dis na di burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides di continual burnt offering, and im drink offering.
For di beginnings of una months una go offer one burnt offering to di Lord: two young bulls, and one ram, seven male lambs of di first year without blemish,
and three tenths of one ephah of fine flour for one meal offering, mixed with oil, for each bull, and two tenths of one ephah of fine flour for one meal offering, mixed with oil, for di one ram,
and one tenth of one ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering to every lamb, for one burnt offering of pleasing aroma, one offering made by fire to di Lord.

Dem drink offerings go be half one hin of wine for one bull, and one third of one hin for di ram, and one fourth of one hin for one lamb. Dis na di burnt offering of every month throughout di months of di year.
Also one male goat for one sin offering to di Lord. E go dey offered, besides di continual burnt offering, and im drink offering.
For di first month, on di 14th day of di month, na di Lord Passover.
On di 15th day of dis month go be one feast. Seven days unleavened bread go dey eaten.
For di first day go be one holy convocation. Una go do no regular work.
But una go offer one offering made by fire, one burnt offering to di Lord: two young bulls, and one ram, and seven male lambs of di first year. Dem go be to una without blemish,
with dem meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. Three tenths of one ephah una go offer for one bull, and two tenths for di ram.
For each lamb of di seven lambs, una go offer one tenth,
and one male goat for one sin offering, to make atonement for una.
Una go offer dem besides di burnt offering of di morning, wey be for one continual burnt offering.
Na so una go offer daily, for seven days, di food of di offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma to di Lord. E go dey offered, besides di continual burnt offering, and im drink offering.
For di seventh day una go get one holy convocation. Una go do no regular work.
Also for di day of di firstfruits, when una offer one new meal offering to di Lord for una feast of weeks, una go get one holy convocation. Una go do no regular work.
But una go offer one burnt offering for pleasing aroma to di Lord: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs of di first year,
and dem meal offering of fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths of one ephah for each bull, two tenths for di one ram,
one tenth for each lamb of di seven lambs,
and one male goat, to make atonement for una.
Besides di continual burnt offering, and im meal offering, una go offer dem, wey dem go be to una without blemish, with dem drink offerings.’”
“‘On di first day of di seventh month una go get one holy convocation. Una go do no regular work. Na one day of blowing of trumpets to una.
Una go offer one burnt offering for pleasing aroma to di Lord: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs of di first year without blemish,
and dem meal offering of fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths of one ephah for di bull, two tenths for di ram,
and one tenth for each of di seven lambs,
and one male goat for one sin offering, to make atonement for una,

besides di burnt offering of di new moon, and im meal offering, and di continual burnt offering and im meal offering, and dem drink offerings, according to dem ordinance, for pleasing aroma, one offering made by fire to di Lord.
On di tenth day of dis seventh month una go get one holy convocation. Una go afflict una souls. Una go do no kind of work,
but una go offer one burnt offering to di Lord for pleasing aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs of di first year. Dem go be to una without blemish,
and dem meal offering of fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths of one ephah for di bull, two tenths for di one ram,
one tenth for each lamb of di seven lambs,
one male goat for one sin offering, besides di sin offering of atonement, and di continual burnt offering, and im meal offering, and dem drink offerings.
On di 15th day of di seventh month una go get one holy convocation. Una go do no regular work, and una go keep one feast to di Lord seven days.
Una go offer one burnt offering, one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma to di Lord: 13 young bulls, two rams, 14 male lambs of di first year. Dem go be without blemish,
and dem meal offering of fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths of one ephah for each bull of di 13 bulls, two tenths for each ram of di two rams,
and one tenth for each lamb of di 14 lambs,
and one male goat for one sin offering, besides di continual burnt offering, im meal offering, and im drink offering.
On di second day una go offer 12 young bulls, two rams, 14 male lambs of di first year without blemish,
and dem meal offering and dem drink offerings for di bulls, for di rams, and for di lambs, according to dem number, after di ordinance,
and one male goat for one sin offering, besides di continual burnt offering, and im meal offering, and dem drink offerings.
On di third day, 11 bulls, two rams, 14 male lambs of di first year without blemish,
and dem meal offering and dem drink offerings for di bulls, for di rams, and for di lambs, according to dem number, after di ordinance,
and one male goat for one sin offering, besides di continual burnt offering, and im meal offering, and im drink offering.
On di fourth day, ten bulls, two rams, 14 male lambs of di first year without blemish,
dem meal offering and dem drink offerings for di bulls, for di rams, and for di lambs, according to dem number, after di ordinance,
and one male goat for one sin offering, besides di continual burnt offering, im meal offering, and im drink offering.
On di fifth day, nine bulls, two rams, 14 male lambs of di first year without blemish,
and dem meal offering and dem drink offerings for di bulls, for di rams, and for di lambs, according to dem number, after di ordinance,
and one male goat for one sin offering, besides di continual burnt offering, and im meal offering, and im drink offering.
On di sixth day, eight bulls, two rams, 14 male lambs of di first year without blemish,
and dem meal offering and dem drink offerings for di bulls, for di rams, and for di lambs, according to dem number, after di ordinance,
and one male goat for one sin offering, besides di continual burnt offering, im meal offering, and dem drink offerings.
On di seventh day, seven bulls, two rams, 14 male lambs of di first year without blemish,
and dem meal offering and dem drink offerings for di bulls, for di rams, and for di lambs, according to dem number, after di ordinance,
and one male goat for one sin offering, besides di continual burnt offering, im meal offering, and im drink offering.
On di eighth day una go get one solemn assembly. Una go do no regular work,
but una go offer one burnt offering, one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma to di Lord: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs of di first year without blemish,
dem meal offering and dem drink offerings for di bull, for di ram, and for di lambs, according to dem number, after di ordinance,
and one male goat for one sin offering, besides di continual burnt offering, and im meal offering, and im drink offering.

Dem na wetin una go offer to di Lord for una set feasts, besides una vows, and una free will offerings, for una burnt offerings, and for una meal offerings, and for una drink offerings, and for una peace offerings.’”
Moses tell di pikin dem of Israel according to all wey di Lord command Moses.
Moses speak to di heads of di tribes of di pikin dem of Israel, talk, “Dis na di thing wey di Lord command.
When one man vow one vow to di Lord, or swear one oath to bind im soul with one bond, e no go break im word. E go do according to all wey proceed out of im mouth.
Also when one woman vow one vow to di Lord, and bind imself by one bond, while di woman dey for im papa house for im youth,
and di papa hear di vow, and di bond wey di woman bind im soul with, and di papa hold im peace to am, all di vows go stand, and every bond wey di woman bind im soul with go stand.
But if di papa forbid am for di day wey e hear, none of di vows, or of di bonds wey di woman bind im soul with, go stand. Di Lord go forgive di woman, because im papa forbid am.
If di woman marry one husband, while di vows dey on am, or di rash utterance of im lips, wey e bind im soul with,
and di husband hear am, and hold im peace to am for di day wey e hear am, di vows go stand, and di bonds wey di woman bind im soul with go stand.
But if di husband forbid am for di day wey e hear am, e go make di vow wey dey on am, and di rash utterance of im lips, wey e bind im soul with, of no effect. Di Lord go forgive di woman.
But di vow of one widow, or of one divorced woman, even everything wey di woman don bind im soul with, go stand against am.
If di woman vow for di husband house, or bind im soul by one bond with one oath,
and di husband hear am, and hold im peace to am, and no forbid am, all di vows go stand, and every bond wey di woman bind im soul with go stand.

But if di husband don make dem of no effect for di day wey e hear dem, whatever proceed out of im lips concerning di vows, or concerning di bond of im soul, no go stand. Di husband don make dem of no effect. Di Lord go forgive di woman.
Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict di soul, di husband fit establish am, or di husband fit make am of no effect.
But if di husband altogether hold im peace to am from day to day, e establish all di vows, or all di bonds wey dey on am. E don establish dem, because e hold im peace to am for di day wey e hear dem.
But if e make dem of no effect after e don hear dem, e go bear im iniquity.”
Dem na di statutes, wey di Lord command Moses, between one man and im wife, between one papa and im pikin woman, while e dey for im youth for im papa house.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Avenge di pikin dem of Israel of di Midianites. After dat you go dey gathered to your people.”
Moses speak to di people, talk, “Arm men from among una for war, so that dem go go against Midian, to execute di Lord vengeance on Midian.
Of every tribe one thousand, throughout all di tribes of Israel, una go send to di war.”
So dem dey delivered out of di thousands of Israel, one thousand from every tribe, 12,000 armed for war.
Moses send dem, one thousand from every tribe, to di war, dem and Phinehas di pikin of Eleazar di priest, to di war, with di vessels of di sanctuary and di trumpets for signalling for im hand.
Dem fight against Midian, as di Lord command Moses, and dem kill every male.
Dem kill di kings of Midian with di rest of dem wey dem kill: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, di five kings of Midian. Dem kill Balaam di pikin of Beor with di sword.
Di pikin dem of Israel take captive di women of Midian and dem little ones. Dem take as plunder all dem livestock, and all dem flocks, and all dem goods.
Dem burn all dem cities wia dem dwell, and all dem encampments, with fire.
Dem take all di plunder, and all di prey, both of man and of animal.

Dem bring di captives, and di prey, and di plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar di priest, and to di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel, to di camp for di plains of Moab, wey dey by di Jordan at Jericho.
Moses, and Eleazar di priest, and all di princes of di congregation, go out to meet dem outside di camp.
Moses dey angry with di officers of di army, di captains of thousands and di captains of hundreds, wey come from di service of di war.
Moses talk to dem, “Una don save all di women alive?
Look, dem na di ones wey, through di counsel of Balaam, cause di pikin dem of Israel to commit trespass against di Lord for di matter of Peor, and so di plague dey among di congregation of di Lord.
Now therefore kill every male among di little ones, and kill every woman wey don know man by lying with am.
But all di girls wey no know man by lying with am, keep alive for yourselves.
Encamp outside di camp seven days. Whoever don kill any person, and whoever don touch any slain, purify yourselves and your captives on di third day and on di seventh day.
Purify every garment, and everything wey dem make of skin, and all work of goats hair, and everything wey dem make of wood.”
Eleazar di priest talk to di men of war wey go to di battle, “Dis na di statute of di law wey di Lord command Moses:
only di gold, and di silver, di bronze, di iron, di tin, and di lead,

everything wey fit endure fire, una go make am go through di fire, and e go dey clean. Nevertheless e go dey purified with di water of impurity. All wey no fit endure fire una go make go through di water.
Una go wash una clothes on di seventh day, and una go dey clean. After dat una go come into di camp.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Take di count of di plunder wey dem take, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar di priest, and di heads of di papa houses of di congregation.
Divide di plunder into two parts, between di men skilled in war, wey go out to battle, and all di congregation.
Levy one tribute to di Lord of di men of war wey go out to battle: one soul of every 500, of di persons, and of di cattle, and of di donkeys, and of di flocks.
Take am from dem half, and give am to Eleazar di priest, for di Lord heave offering.

Of di pikin dem of Israel half, you go take one portion of every 50, of di persons, of di cattle, of di donkeys, and of di flocks, of all di animals, and give dem to di Levites, wey keep di charge of di tabernacle of di Lord.”
Moses and Eleazar di priest do as di Lord command Moses.
Now di plunder, over and above di booty wey di men of war take, na 675,000 sheep,
72,000 cattle,
61,000 donkeys,
and 32,000 persons in all, of di women wey no know man by lying with am.
Di half, wey be di portion of dem wey go out to war, in number na 337,500 sheep,
and di Lord tribute of di sheep na 675.
Di cattle na 36,000, from wey di Lord tribute na 72.
Di donkeys na 30,500, from wey di Lord tribute na 61.
Di persons na 16,000, from wey di Lord tribute na 32 persons.
Moses give di tribute, wey be di Lord heave offering, to Eleazar di priest, as di Lord command Moses.
Of di pikin dem of Israel half, wey Moses divide off from di men wey fight,
now di congregation half na 337,500 sheep,
36,000 cattle,
30,500 donkeys,
and 16,000 persons,

even of di pikin dem of Israel half, Moses take one portion of every 50, both of man and of animal, and give dem to di Levites, wey keep di charge of di tabernacle of di Lord, as di Lord command Moses.
Di officers wey dey over di thousands of di army, di captains of thousands, and di captains of hundreds, come near to Moses.
Dem talk to Moses, “Your servants don take di count of di men of war wey dey under our charge, and no man of us dey missing.
We don bring di Lord offering, wetin every man don get, of jewels of gold, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before di Lord.”
Moses and Eleazar di priest take di gold from dem, even all di worked jewels.
All di gold of di offering wey dem offer up to di Lord, from di captains of thousands, and from di captains of hundreds, na 16,750 shekels.
Di men of war don take plunder, every man for imself.
Moses and Eleazar di priest take di gold from di captains of thousands and of hundreds, and bring am into di Tent of Meeting, for one memorial for di pikin dem of Israel before di Lord.
Now di pikin dem of Reuben and di pikin dem of Gad get one very great multitude of livestock. Dem see di land of Jazer, and di land of Gilead, and look, di place na one place for livestock.
Di pikin dem of Gad and di pikin dem of Reuben come and speak to Moses, and to Eleazar di priest, and to di princes of di congregation, talk,
“Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
di land wey di Lord strike before di congregation of Israel, na one land for livestock, and your servants get livestock.”
Dem talk, “If we don find favour for your sight, make dem give dis land to your servants for possession. Make una no bring us over di Jordan.”
Moses talk to di pikin dem of Gad and to di pikin dem of Reuben, “Una brothers go go to war, and una go sit here?
Why una discourage di heart of di pikin dem of Israel from going over into di land wey di Lord don give dem?
Na so una papa dem do, when I send dem from Kadesh Barnea to see di land.
Because when dem go up to di valley of Eshcol, and see di land, dem discourage di heart of di pikin dem of Israel, so that dem no go into di land wey di Lord don give dem.
Di Lord anger dey kindled for dat day, and e swear, talk,
‘Surely none of di men wey come up out of Egypt, from 20 years old and above, go see di land wey I swear to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, because dem no fully follow me,
except Caleb di pikin of Jephunneh di Kenizzite, and Joshua di pikin of Nun, because dem fully follow di Lord.’
Di Lord anger dey kindled against Israel, and e make dem wander for di wilderness 40 years, until all di generation, wey don do evil for di sight of di Lord, dey consumed.
Look, una don rise up in una papa dem place, one increase of sinful men, to increase again di fierce anger of di Lord toward Israel.
If una turn away from following am, e go again leave dem for di wilderness, and una go destroy all dis people.”
Dem come near to am, and talk, “We go build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones,
but we ourselves go dey armed ready to go before di pikin dem of Israel, until we don bring dem to dem place. Our little ones go dwell for di fortified cities because of di inhabitants of di land.
We no go return to our houses, until di pikin dem of Israel don inherit every man im inheritance.
We no go inherit with dem on di other side of di Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance don fall to us on dis side of di Jordan toward di east.”
Moses talk to dem, “If una go do dis thing, if una go arm yourselves to go before di Lord to di war,
and all una armed men go over di Jordan before di Lord, until e don drive out im enemies from before am,
and di land dey subdued before di Lord, afterward una go return, and una go dey blameless toward di Lord, and toward Israel. Dis land go be una possession before di Lord.
But if una no do so, look, una don sin against di Lord, and know say una sin go find una out.
Build cities for una little ones, and folds for una sheep, and do wetin don proceed out of una mouth.”
Di pikin dem of Gad and di pikin dem of Reuben speak to Moses, talk, “Your servants go do as my oga command.
Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock go dey dere for di cities of Gilead,
but your servants go pass over, every man wey dey armed for war, before di Lord to battle, as my oga talk.”
So Moses command Eleazar di priest, and Joshua di pikin of Nun, and di heads of di papa houses of di tribes of di pikin dem of Israel concerning dem.

Moses talk to dem, “If di pikin dem of Gad and di pikin dem of Reuben go pass with una over di Jordan, every man wey dey armed for battle, before di Lord, and di land dey subdued before una, una go give dem di land of Gilead for possession.
But if dem no go over with una armed, dem go get possessions among una for di land of Canaan.”
Di pikin dem of Gad and di pikin dem of Reuben answer, talk, “As di Lord don talk to your servants, so we go do.
We go pass over armed before di Lord into di land of Canaan, and di possession of our inheritance go dey with us beyond di Jordan.”

Moses give to dem, to di pikin dem of Gad, and to di pikin dem of Reuben, and to half di tribe of Manasseh di pikin of Joseph, di kingdom of Sihon king of di Amorites, and di kingdom of Og king of Bashan, di land, with di cities of am wey dey within di borders, even di cities of di surrounding land.
Di pikin dem of Gad build Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
Atroth Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran, fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
Di pikin dem of Reuben build Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
Nebo, and Baal Meon, wey dem change dem names, and Sibmah. Dem give other names to di cities wey dem build.
Di pikin dem of Machir di pikin of Manasseh go to Gilead, and take am, and drive out di Amorites wey dey inside am.
Moses give Gilead to Machir di pikin of Manasseh, and e dwell inside am.
Jair di pikin of Manasseh go and take dem towns, and call dem Havvoth Jair.
Nobah go and take Kenath, and di villages of am, and call am Nobah, after im own name.
Dem na di stages of di pikin dem of Israel, wey go out of di land of Egypt by dem armies under di hand of Moses and Aaron.
Moses write dem starting places, according to dem stages, by di commandment of di Lord. Dem na dem stages according to dem starting places.
Dem journey from Rameses for di first month, on di 15th day of di first month. On di next day after di Passover di pikin dem of Israel go out with one high hand for di sight of all di Egyptians,
while di Egyptians dey bury all dem firstborn, wey di Lord don strike among dem. Upon dem gods too di Lord execute judgments.
Di pikin dem of Israel journey from Rameses, and encamp for Succoth.
Dem journey from Succoth, and encamp for Etham, wey dey di edge of di wilderness.
Dem journey from Etham, and turn back to Pi Hahiroth, wey dey before Baal Zephon, and dem encamp before Migdol.
Dem journey from before Hahiroth, and pass through di middle of di sea into di wilderness. Dem go three days journey for di wilderness of Etham, and encamp for Marah.
Dem journey from Marah, and come to Elim. For Elim dere dey 12 springs of water, and 70 palm trees, and dem encamp dere.
Dem journey from Elim, and encamp by di Red Sea.
Dem journey from di Red Sea, and encamp for di wilderness of Sin.
Dem journey from di wilderness of Sin, and encamp for Dophkah.
Dem journey from Dophkah, and encamp for Alush.
Dem journey from Alush, and encamp for Rephidim, wia no water dey for di people to drink.
Dem journey from Rephidim, and encamp for di wilderness of Sinai.
Dem journey from di wilderness of Sinai, and encamp for Kibroth Hattaavah.
Dem journey from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamp for Hazeroth.
Dem journey from Hazeroth, and encamp for Rithmah.
Dem journey from Rithmah, and encamp for Rimmon Perez.
Dem journey from Rimmon Perez, and encamp for Libnah.
Dem journey from Libnah, and encamp for Rissah.
Dem journey from Rissah, and encamp for Kehelathah.
Dem journey from Kehelathah, and encamp for Mount Shepher.
Dem journey from Mount Shepher, and encamp for Haradah.
Dem journey from Haradah, and encamp for Makheloth.
Dem journey from Makheloth, and encamp for Tahath.
Dem journey from Tahath, and encamp for Terah.
Dem journey from Terah, and encamp for Mithkah.
Dem journey from Mithkah, and encamp for Hashmonah.
Dem journey from Hashmonah, and encamp for Moseroth.
Dem journey from Moseroth, and encamp for Bene Jaakan.
Dem journey from Bene Jaakan, and encamp for Hor Haggidgad.
Dem journey from Hor Haggidgad, and encamp for Jotbathah.
Dem journey from Jotbathah, and encamp for Abronah.
Dem journey from Abronah, and encamp for Ezion Geber.
Dem journey from Ezion Geber, and encamp for di wilderness of Zin, wey na Kadesh.
Dem journey from Kadesh, and encamp for Mount Hor, for di edge of di land of Edom.

Aaron di priest go up into Mount Hor at di commandment of di Lord, and die dere, for di 40th year after di pikin dem of Israel come out of di land of Egypt, for di fifth month, on di first day of di month.
Aaron dey 123 years old when e die for Mount Hor.
Di Canaanite, di king of Arad, wey dwell for di South for di land of Canaan, hear of di coming of di pikin dem of Israel.
Dem journey from Mount Hor, and encamp for Zalmonah.
Dem journey from Zalmonah, and encamp for Punon.
Dem journey from Punon, and encamp for Oboth.
Dem journey from Oboth, and encamp for Iye Abarim, for di border of Moab.
Dem journey from Iim, and encamp for Dibon Gad.
Dem journey from Dibon Gad, and encamp for Almon Diblathaim.
Dem journey from Almon Diblathaim, and encamp for di mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
Dem journey from di mountains of Abarim, and encamp for di plains of Moab by di Jordan at Jericho.
Dem encamp by di Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim for di plains of Moab.
Di Lord speak to Moses for di plains of Moab by di Jordan at Jericho, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘When una pass over di Jordan into di land of Canaan,
una go drive out all di inhabitants of di land from before una, and destroy all dem engraved stones, and destroy all dem molten images, and demolish all dem high places.
Una go take possession of di land, and dwell inside am, because I don give di land to una to possess am.

Una go inherit di land by lot according to una families. To di more una go give di more inheritance, and to di fewer una go give di less inheritance. Wherever di lot fall to any man, dat one go be im own. According to di tribes of una papa dem una go inherit.

But if una no drive out di inhabitants of di land from before una, dem wey una let remain of dem go be as thorns for una eyes, and as pricks for una sides, and dem go harass una for di land wia una dwell.
E go come be say, as I think to do to dem, I go do to una.’”
